subject: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your product demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@fastmetrics.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0000
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your product demo

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! We're excited to show how our inference platform can help reduce inference costs and improve latency for FastMetrics.

If you'd like a short 30-minute walkthrough, you can pick a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Suggested agenda (attached):
- Quick intro + your goals (5–7m)
- Demo: serving, routing, and cost controls (15m)
- Q&A + next steps (8–10m)

If none of the times work, reply with a few windows that fit your calendar and I'll coordinate.

Attachments:
- 20260610-redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@fastmetrics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — schedule your product demo

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick note. I booked the 3:00 PM PT slot via the Calendly link, but I realized that I need to push the meeting to next week. Could we move it to Tue 16th or Wed 17th between 10–12 PT? Also, can you include our head of infra, Priya Natarajan, on the invite — she'll want to cover security questions.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of ML Ops
FastMetrics

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — Tue 16th at 10:30 AM PT works for our team. I updated the booking and sent a calendar invite (Redwood Demo — FastMetrics). Please accept when you get a moment.

I've cc'd Aditya from our solutions team so he can run the demo and handle any deep infra questions. Aditya — can you lead the call on Tue 16th, 10:30 AM PT? Aim for a 30-minute walkthrough; priority items Jordan called out: cost/unit economics, routing/fallbacks, and SOC 2 evidence.

Meeting details:
- When: Tue, 16 Jun 2026, 10:30 AM–11:00 AM PT (converted to recipient timezone in calendar invite)

- If you'd like SOC 2 artifacts ahead of time, Priya, I can send a redacted SOC 2 summary and our security whitepaper — let me know which you prefer.
